reference.question: \(f(x)=x+1\) when \(x<0\), and \(f(x)=2x\) when \(x\geq 0\). Find \(f(3)\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Choose the applicable piece

\(3\geq 0\), so use the second piece, \(f(x)=2x\): \(2\times 3=6\).
